description: Government Form & Procedure Finder (California, San Diego) — Given a plain-language situation (for example a city took belongings in an encampment sweep, a parking ticket, a contractor overcharge), returns the official government or court forms and procedures that apply, each with its official URL, issuer, how and where to file, fee, and the filing deadline computed from a reference date where a rule sets one. Covers California statewide plus the City and C

as_of.description: Reference date YYYY-MM-DD, taken as the trigger of each forward deadline rule (incident date, citation date, notice mailing date); each match names its trigger. Rules that count back from a future event (hearing, election) are returned without a date. Omit to get the rules without due dates.

city.description: e.g. San Diego. A city of San Diego implies San Diego County.

county.description: e.g. San Diego. Omit if unknown.

state.description: Uppercase two-letter state code. Only CA has entries.

situation.description: Plain-language description of what happened or what the person wants to do.

name: form-finder
